_about: ROUND 1 OF THE 3b-2 ROUTE PHASE (the knights see and shoot): the player waits on the 1010 block 256 ticks and boards the moving platform at its top instead of falling onto it low: the walk off the block is on 584 (314 in the earlier timeline) and the second walk from 650 (485); the rest is unchanged.
3-03 (step 127, R1: antiportal_1018's 32 x 3.8 = 122 px holds the door's platform and the gap before
it, so no portal opens there). The old way over the gap - a portal high at (806, 70), one low in the
gap, the fall through the one and the rise out of the other - no longer reaches the door's platform:
the timing group's fall is 4000 u/s2, so the player enters the gap's portal after a fall of ~30 px
and comes out rising 33 px (round 1's try: apex y 138.9 against the 122.5 he needs). This route
bridges the gap with the level's own crate instead (round 2):
it is teleportable, 58 px wide for a gap of 64, and the single block at the gap's foot lies 58 px
below both platforms, so a crate that falls into the gap lies flush with them.
The first four taps are the old route's, re-timed to the new flights (24 + 3.2 u a tick): a portal
over block00_low_emissive_ent_981 at (330, 120) and one on the player; right onto the crate; a portal
over single_block_plat_low_emissive_ent_1010 at (600, 70) and one on the player on the crate: he
comes out on that block on tick 198. Right to the end of its top (x 630.2, where the view reaches
x 857), one portal in the gap's top at (857, 150) - 130.8 u from the antiportal's centre, against
its 121.6 - which opens on tick 313; back left to x 611, where the ray to the crate clears the
block's corner, and a second portal 4 px over the crate's top at (416, 162). It opens on tick 376
with the crate inside it as it opens (an entry is an edge: a body already in a portal when the
second one opens is carried, one in a lone portal is not), so the crate goes through on that tick,
falls into the gap and lies at (861, 173) with its top on 144 from tick 391.
The moving platform (step 154: it swings 68 either side of y 172 at 1 rad a second from a stride DOWN,
y = 172 + 68 cos(0.016 x tick), carries a rider up and down and not sideways) is boarded at its top: the platform is level with the 1010 block (y 104, its top on 589)

and the walk off the block (584 to 598) puts him on it as it starts down (tick 600, at x 646); he stands on it and rides it down, and the walk right from 650 takes him off it onto the far block as its top
passes 144 going down (676, at x 680), over the crate and the door's platform and into the door. Boarding it low, as the timing group's route did (tick 340, platform at y 217, the ride to its
bottom and back up), is a ride in the knight's row; walking on without waiting carries him off the platform's far end while it is still low.

THE KNIGHT (planning steps 158 and 159: it sees and shoots; this route has no sighting: no exclamation, no enemy_shot). Knight 913 patrols y 217 between wayB0 (x 473, 2000 ms) and wayB1 (x 612, 4000 ms): it holds at x 480 until about 250, walks right

to x 605, holds until about 632 facing right, walks back left (facing left to about 872) and holds at x 480. It looks along the row floor(y / 128) = 1, three 128-unit buckets along its facing. The earlier timeline rode the platform down to y 240

(the player's centre y 206) from 340 to 500, in its row and within its buckets, and it spotted him on 337 and shot him dead on 411. Now he waits on the 1010 block (y 72) while the knight goes round, and from the block on to the door his centre is at y 72 to 127.6: row 0, never the knight's.

The crate's top is the one place near the boundary (127.1 to 127.6 at x 842 to 890, 0.4 under the 128 line, ticks 730 to 750), where the knight faces left as well. Of the portals, (330, 120) and (600, 70) are in row 0; (857, 150) and (416, 162), in row 1, draw no sighting either: the run's sounds hold no enemy_spotted and no enemy_shot.

Won on tick 776 (the walk off the block on 584-598 with the second walk from 650; 265 to 275 and 645 to 655 in 5-tick steps all win, on 770 to 781). Round 1 of the 3b-1 route phase: the time-base group's build: every body in the original's 1/30 s

step, the player's capsule, the platforms as linearMotion swings them. Leans on the port's rider carry (a rider is carried up and down by the platform's velocity, his feet within 0.01 unit of its top: the port's carry, not the original's push-out and fall, planning step 154 decision 1, deviations 1 and 4), on the platform swinging from the level's first tick (step 154 deviation 2, the bucket clock is not modelled); the original's platform is outside its drawn buckets at the spawn (step 154 decision 6) and may not swing until the camera comes near, which would move this route's boarding and walk-off ticks.
